statement: Pi's pinned agent core uses an inner loop for model/tool/steering turns and an outer loop for queued follow-up messages, emitting explicit agent, turn, message, and tool lifecycle events throughout.

display_text.zh-CN: 固定版本的 Pi agent core 使用内层循环处理 model/tool/steering turn，外层循环处理排队的 follow-up message，并持续发送 agent、turn、message 与 tool 生命周期事件。
display_text.en: Pi's pinned agent core uses an inner loop for model/tool/steering turns and an outer loop for queued follow-up messages, emitting explicit agent, turn, message, and tool lifecycle events throughout.

notes: This maps the reusable agent package and its coding-agent integration; no provider call was made.
